Baby Shark Dance.text: An earlier German version, set to the Jaws theme, has the baby shark grow up and eat a swimmer.
Baby Shark Dance.evidence: A dance version of "Baby Shark" was popularized in the 2007 YouTube video "Kleiner Hai" (German for Little Shark) published by Alexandra Müller, also known by her stage name Alemuel. This version, set to the theme of Jaws, tells the story of a baby shark who grows up and eats a swimmer.

Wheels on the Bus.text: In 2002 a Madonna impersonator, "Mad Donna", reached No. 17 in the UK singing it over "Ray of Light".
Wheels on the Bus.evidence: In 2002, American Madonna impersonator Michelle Chappel, under the stage name "Mad Donna", released a single which sampled the song, featuring a version of Madonna's 1998 song "Ray of Light" over which the classic children's song was sung. The single reached No. 17 in the United Kingdom and also made the charts elsewhere in Europe.

Despacito.text: It was the first Spanish-language song to top the Billboard Hot 100 since "Macarena" in 1996.
Despacito.evidence: In the United States, it became the first Spanish-language song to top the Billboard Hot 100 since "Macarena" in 1996, subsequently tying as the longest-reigning number one on the Billboard Hot 100 at the time with 16 weeks, as well as becoming the longest-running number one on the Hot Latin Songs chart with 56 weeks from 2017 to 2026.

Johny Johny Yes Papa.text: A 1989 book records the rhyme being told in Kenya as far back as 1980.
Johny Johny Yes Papa.evidence: A 1989 book by the American scholar and professor Francelia Butler records the poem being told in Kenya in 1980.

See You Again.text: It was commissioned for Furious 7 as a tribute to actor Paul Walker.
See You Again.evidence: Produced by Puth, DJ Frank E and Andrew Cedar, who also co-wrote the song with Khalifa, the song was commissioned for the soundtrack of the 2015 film Furious 7 as a tribute to Fast & Furious actor Paul Walker, who died in a single-vehicle crash on November 30, 2013.

Shape of You.text: Despite mixed reviews from critics, it reached number one in 34 countries.
Shape of You.evidence: Despite receiving mixed reviews from music critics, "Shape of You" peaked at number one on the singles charts of 34 countries, including the US Billboard Hot 100—later becoming the best performing song of 2017—as well as in the British, Australian, Canadian and Irish singles charts.

Axel F.text: The frog's vocals come from a 1997 recording by Daniel Malmedahl called "2TAKTARE.mp3".
Axel F.evidence: The song consists of additional vocals taken from the 1997 recording "2TAKTARE.mp3" by Daniel Malmedahl.

Gangnam Style.text: Of the ten-plus locations in the video, only two were actually filmed in the Gangnam district.
Gangnam Style.evidence: Of the ten-plus locations seen in the video, only two were actually filmed in the Gangnam district.
